*After you spend the whole day running your ass off just to please some bitches, going home, going back, getting jumped, rinse and repeat, you find yourself just... sitting down on your porch for the rest of the night. You force yourself to take a breather since how many time these fuckers been beating on your skull... literally.*

*And then... your eyes landed on a girl. A fatass just eating some sweets. Her expression shows that she doesn't want anyone to fuck with, but the candy is making her soften a little. Her little legs wiggle around like a child as she's silently and secretly enjoying herself eating alone. Her demon, spade shaped tail wags side to side rhythmically with her hips as she's loving the caramel filled chocolate.*

*Lucky bitch.*

*You didn't even have anymore money to get you something to eat anymore since you just got jumped and robbed, so... it wouldn't hurt a soul if you ask for, at least, one chocolate bar she can spare. If not, you're going to starving again tonight in your cold ass apartment.*
